# Plan Quality Checklist: Wave 1 Functional Hardening

**Purpose**: Validate that the 014 requirements and planning artifacts are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and ready for `/speckit-tasks`.
**Created**: 2026-05-31
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements. Items test requirement and plan quality, not implementation behavior.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are the four scoped Wave-1 areas and all 16 `Tutorial` steps completely enumerated across the spec, contract, and data model? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Contract §1, Data Model §Scoped Review Matrix]
- [ ] CHK002 Are historical-source requirements complete for `Desklogo`, `MsgCls`, `Tutorial`, and `Videomode`, including the Desklogo asset/generator boundary? [Completeness, Spec §FR-003-FR-006, Contract §3, Plan §Phase 2]
- [ ] CHK003 Are all required `pr-evidence.md` matrix fields specified, including source, C# behavior, proof method, helper classification, fallback proof, missing-core decision, deviation, documentation trigger, and validation evidence? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, Contract §2]
- [ ] CHK004 Are out-of-scope boundaries complete for Wave 2/3/4, visual remediation, broad framework work, mouse-only workflow, new dependencies, database, services, network, and runtime/product AI? [Completeness, Spec §FR-020, Plan §Constraints, Contract §1]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK005 Is the distinction between executable smoke proof and evidence-only proof objectively defined for all no-runtime-target cases? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023, Contract §4, Research §Decision 3]
- [ ] CHK006 Is `PrimaryProof` defined with enough objective criteria to distinguish it from `SetupOnly`, `SupplementalProof`, and `LegacyOrTemporary`? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016/FR-025, Contract §5, Data Model §HelperClassification]
- [ ] CHK007 Are missing-core-function decisions defined with clear necessity, feasibility, decision, proof-status, and rationale fields? [Clarity, Spec §FR-027, Data Model §MissingCoreFunctionDecision, Research §Decision 6]
- [ ] CHK008 Are learner-facing documentation update triggers clear enough to avoid both unnecessary guide churn and missing learner-visible changes? [Clarity, Spec §FR-028, Contract §9, Research §Decision 8]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK009 Do the spec, plan, research, data model, and contract consistently identify `specs/014-wave1-functional-hardening/pr-evidence.md` as the primary proof matrix? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007, Plan §Baseline Assumptions, Research §Decision 2, Contract §2]
- [ ] CHK010 Are guide and `examples/README.md` update rules consistent between the spec, plan, research, contract, and quickstart? [Consistency, Spec §FR-024/FR-028, Plan §Baseline Assumptions, Contract §9, Quickstart §8]
- [ ] CHK011 Are validation requirements consistent between the plan, contract, and quickstart, especially conditional DocFX/web-a11y execution? [Consistency, Plan §Testing, Contract §11, Quickstart §9]
- [ ] CHK012 Are AI-SBOM and other governance applicability decisions consistent across constitution requirements, plan, research, and contract? [Consistency, Spec §CR-006-CR-010, Plan §Constitution Check, Research §Decision 10, Contract §10]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK015 Are evidence-only acceptance cases tied to required proof-boundary fields so reviewer discretion is bounded? [Acceptance Criteria Quality, Spec §FR-023/SC-007, Contract §4/§8]
- [ ] CHK016 Are final validation evidence requirements explicit enough for future tasks to request command output, failures, blockers, or equivalent evidence? [Acceptance Criteria Quality, Contract §11, Quickstart §9, Plan §Phase 2]
